_metadata.description: Flow definition with sync scopes for all 6 Tier 2 solutions (ACV, SSC, AAM, CMM, FUS, CAA). Each scope queries the solution's latest validation, maps status, and upserts the corresponding fsi_controlassessment record. Per-solution sync results are collected and reported via Teams.
_metadata.schedule: Daily at 6:30 AM UTC (30 min after Tier 2 daily scans)
_metadata.note: This JSON is a flow template. Import into Power Automate and configure all fsi_INT_ControlGuid_* and Teams parameters before activation. A Validate_Parameters guard terminates the flow if any required control GUID is empty.
_metadata.pagination_note: All ListRecords use $top=1 intentionally. If $top is removed, @odata.nextLink pagination handling must be added.
